instruction: Make sure Chrome's pop-up blocker is enabled to prevent unwanted pop-up windows.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Chrome's pop-up blocker setting. This is a similar Chrome privacy/security setting to the original Safe Browsing task. Custom getter get_popup_blocker_enabled__413d12f972e5a2b523411485f2d493b1 reads Chrome's Preferences file and checks profile.default_content_setting_values.popups (value 2 = blocked, 1 = allowed). Verified against Chrome's preferences structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: reads Chrome Preferences file from correct OS-specific paths and extracts profile.default_content_setting_values.popups setting
Getter correctly interprets Chrome's pop-up blocker values: value 2 = blocked (enabled), value 1 = allowed (disabled)
Getter returns correct string values: 'true' when pop-ups are blocked (setting=2), 'false' when allowed (setting=1)
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares result string with expected string from rules['expected']
Expected value is semantically correct: 'true' indicates pop-up blocker is enabled
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction (pop-up blocker enabled)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are re-read from disk after user modifications
Data flow is correct: getter extracts state as string -> metric compares strings -> returns 1.0 if enabled
Edge case handling: getter defaults to 'true' (enabled) on error, which matches Chrome's default behavior
